decision: Selected the planar centroid of the BBPP_ProjectArea polygon from the proponent geospatial data that the Impact Assessment Agency of Canada publishes for the Black Bear Power Plant Project (registry reference 88747) as the campus locator, replacing the imported text coordinate of the project area's south end. The adjacent data-centre land is not located by any published source, so the point marks the power plant project area that anchors the Black Bear campus. The centroid is computed in the layer's projected CRS and transformed to WGS84, so it is recorded as a compiled reference with a coordinate_transform derivation.
layer: BBPP_ProjectArea.shp inside the registry ZIP 160299E.zip (one polygon, 8 vertices). The .prj is NAD_1983_CSRS_UTM_Zone_11N (EPSG:2955). Read with a stdlib shapefile parser; centroid and area computed in that CRS with shapely 2.1.1 and the centroid transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj 3.7.1 from the .prj WKT (NAD83(CSRS) is treated as coincident with WGS84 at the metre level).

selected_properties.layer: BBPP_Project Area (PDF page 224 of the Initial Project Description)
selected_properties.registry_document: Supporting Geospatial Data - Initial Project Description (document 160298; the document page gives document date and dcterms.issued 2024-11-06 and says the data were provided on 6 November 2024; the registry listing shows 2024-11-05)

facts.other_layers_not_used: Equipment footprint, roads, ditch line, gas pipeline and transmission line route options, switching station options and field-delineated wetland.
facts.previous_point_note: The imported point is the coordinate of the project area's south end stated in the 2024 project description (SW and SE quarters of Section 15-64-11-W5M); it lies at the polygon's southern edge.
